stem:
The diagram shows Harun's lifting electromagnet on a crane. A coil on an iron core is joined to a cell through a switch. Iron scrap sits under the electromagnet. A plastic button sits nearby.

Which prediction is correct?

options.text: Switch ON: the electromagnet picks up the iron scrap. Switch OFF: it releases the iron scrap.
Switch ON: the electromagnet releases the iron scrap. Switch OFF: it picks up the iron scrap.
Switch ON: the electromagnet picks up the iron scrap and the plastic button.
Switch OFF: the electromagnet keeps holding the iron scrap as strongly as when the switch was ON.

teacher.key_rationale: Current ON makes the electromagnet attract iron, so scrap is lifted; OFF removes that magnetism and the scrap is released. Plastic is not attracted. Holding after OFF treats the electromagnet like a permanent magnet.
teacher.figure_note: Crane electromagnet with cell, switch, iron scrap, and plastic button.
